_doc: Rumours and rumbles about Cinnabar Island and the southern sea (start of the original anime). quests.gd mixes a teller's lines into their talk; a rumour is 'heard' the first time any teller tells it and then shows in the quest log's Rumours tab. requires: a flag (set by quests) or 'rumor:<id>' (another rumour heard first). Gossip, not exposition: mysteries stay open.

rumors.title: The ground shook
rumors.summary: Tremors in the night. Old Tom blames Cinnabar's volcano, across the sea to the south.

tom: Felt the ground shake last night, lad. Rattled my ship's bell.
That's the old mountain on Cinnabar, clearing its throat.
ben: Ground shivered last night. Felt it in the soil.
mae: My teacups rattled in the night, dearie.
Last time that happened I was a girl, and Cinnabar smoked for a week.
delia: Did you feel that little shake last night? I thought it was you falling out of bed again, sweetie.
timmy: Grandpa says a giant fire POKéMON rolled over in its sleep!
jenny: Our station logged it: five past one in the morning, eleven seconds of shaking.
The observatory traced it to deep under Cinnabar's volcano. A long way to shake our road.

rumors.title: Smoke over Cinnabar
rumors.summary: Some mornings a thin plume rises from Cinnabar's mountain. Gus logs it; Tom watches through his spyglass.

gus: Logged at dawn: thin white smoke over Cinnabar. Third time this month.
It's not alarming. It's just... noted.
tom: Through the glass this morning: a grey feather of smoke off Cinnabar.
Mountain's breathing. Has been all my life, on and off.
kai: Ferry fellows on the radio say Cinnabar's smoking a bit. Volcano's fine, they say. Probably.
marina: Ferry men say ash dusted their decks on the Cinnabar run. Grey as Tom's beard.

rumors.title: Cinnabar's hot springs
rumors.summary: Cinnabar's hot springs are famous. Warm water drifts north on the current when the mountain stirs.

mae: I took the waters at the Cinnabar springs, once. Honeymoon.
Hot as a kettle. Smelled of eggs. Most romantic week of my life.
marina: Water's warm off the point. Warm from the south.
When Cinnabar's springs run hot, the whole sea lane warms a little.
rose: I've read orchids grow wild near the Cinnabar springs. Oh, to see them.
bram: Hot springs! I'd prove my dough in one. Imagine the crust!

rumors.title: Blaine and his riddles
rumors.summary: Cinnabar's Gym Leader, Blaine, is a fiery old master who loves riddles and quizzes. They say his gym is hard to find.

tom: Cinnabar's Gym Leader is Blaine. Fire POKéMON. Hot-headed, sharp as a hook.
He loves a riddle. Won't battle you till you've answered his quiz.
gus: Blaine. Bald head, dark glasses, white moustache. Logged him on the ferry once.
Or someone dressed as him. Hard to say. He likes disguises, they say.
ada: Did you hear about Blaine? The fire man on Cinnabar?
He asks you riddles and if you're wrong he sets your hat on fire! ...I think.
kai: They say you can't even FIND Blaine's gym. Trainers go round in circles. Need a riddle to get in!
timmy: Blaine has a FIRE gym in a VOLCANO! And he asks you sums! I hate sums!

rumors.title: The quiz doors
rumors.summary: Inside Blaine's gym, quiz machines guard the doors. Answer right and the door opens; answer wrong and you face a trainer.

tom: A fellow I sailed with took Blaine's challenge. Doors with quiz machines!
Get one wrong and a trainer jumps you. Get 'em all right and Blaine's waiting. Smiling.
gus: The question is never what you expect, the challengers say. Blaine likes it that way.

rumors.title: The burned mansion
rumors.summary: An old mansion on Cinnabar where scientists once worked burned down years ago. It still stands, scorched and empty.

tom: There's an old mansion on Cinnabar. POKéMON Mansion, they call it.
Scientists lived there. Then it burned. Nobody rebuilt. Nobody wants to.
gus: I logged the night it burned. Orange on the horizon till dawn.
I was a young man. The sea looked like it was on fire.
ada: That mansion on Cinnabar is HAUNTED, dear. Ghost scientists!
A Gastly in a lab coat, Marina said. Or was it Kai?
marina: The burned house on Cinnabar? Ferry men won't moor near it after dark. Superstitious lot.

rumors.title: The scorched journals
rumors.summary: People say journals were found in the burned mansion: notes about a POKéMON discovered deep in a faraway jungle.

tom: A salvage man told me he found pages in that mansion. Burned at the edges.
Scribbles about a jungle far away. A new POKéMON, found deep in it. Then nothing.
gus: I heard of the journals. Dates, places. A jungle in South America.
And something about a birth. I don't know what it means. I didn't log it. I wish I had.
kai: A journal that talks about a POKéMON nobody's ever seen? Incredible. Probably fake. Incredible, though!

rumors.title: The fossil lab
rumors.summary: The Cinnabar POKéMON Lab is said to be bringing fossils back to life: Omanyte, Kabuto, even something from old amber.

kai: The Cinnabar Lab can turn a fossil back into a POKéMON! Technology is incredible!
Helix Fossil, Dome Fossil... they say even old amber.
timmy: From ROCKS! I'm gonna find a rock and send it!
rose: The lab on Cinnabar revives fossils, Lily tells me. Ancient POKéMON, breathing again. Imagine.
lily: Did you know the Cinnabar Lab brings back POKéMON from fossils?
I wonder if there were ancient bug POKéMON. Like a giant Butterfree!
ada: They brought a dinosaur back to life on Cinnabar! A flying one! Or a shell one. Or both!

rumors.title: An island lab exploded
rumors.summary: Sailors whisper that a secret laboratory on some island blew up one night. Nobody will say whose, or what they were making.

gus: Months ago, a flash on the far horizon at night. Not lightning. Not the mountain.
Logged: 'Light, very bright, south-west. Then dark.' No ship reported it.
kai: The radio went wild one night. Talk of a lab on an island, gone up in flames.
Then everyone went quiet. Real quiet. Like somebody told 'em to.
tom: Sailors' gossip. A lab on some island, blown to splinters.
I don't believe half of what sailors say. I am a sailor. So I'd know.
ada: A bakery exploded on an island! No, a lab. A lab exploded. Same thing, if Bram's in charge!
marina: Fishermen from Vermilion found charred wood on the swell. Lab crates, one said. Then he stopped talking.
timmy: A ROBOT POKéMON blew up its own lab! Kai said! Sort of!

rumors.title: The strongest POKéMON?
rumors.summary: A whisper: the scientists on that island were trying to make the strongest POKéMON there is. Some say something walked out of the fire.

gus: One more thing about that night. Kai won't tell you, so I will.
A radio voice said 'it's loose'. Then static. I don't know what 'it' was.
tom: A man in a Vermilion bar told me they were building a POKéMON. From scratch.
'The strongest ever,' he said. Then he went pale and paid for my drink. Odd.
kai: Some people say the scientists made a POKéMON. Made one! From a lab! Okay, that's too incredible even for me.

rumors.title: The Seafoam Islands
rumors.summary: West of Cinnabar lie the icy Seafoam Islands, full of caves. An old legend says a bird of ice lives there.

tom: West of Cinnabar, the Seafoam Islands. Ice caves, in the warm sea! Can you credit it?
Legend says a great bird of ice nests there. Blue as glacier water.
marina: The Seafoam currents are cold as a grudge. Nets come up frosted, some mornings.
mae: My grandmother sang a song about a bird of ice in the Seafoam caves.
When it flew, it snowed. In summer. Pretty song. Sad ending.
lily: There are Seel in the Seafoam Islands! And Jynx! I've seen pictures. Not bugs, but okay.

rumors.title: The Lapras song
rumors.summary: On still nights, keepers and fishermen say they've heard a Lapras singing out on the sea lane to Cinnabar.

gus: On still nights, far out on Route 21... a Lapras sings.
I've heard it four times in forty years. Logged every one. I don't have a word for it.
tom: I saw a Lapras once, lad. Ferried a boy across the bay on its back.
Gentle as a lullaby. They're rare now. Too rare.
kai: Lapras? Ha! If I ever hear one, I'm recording it. Technology is incredible!
mae: My husband swore he heard a Lapras singing the night he proposed. I think it was him humming.

rumors.title: Tentacool blooms
rumors.summary: When the water warms from the south, Tentacool swarm off the point. Fishers keep their boats in and the kids off the beach.

marina: Tentacool bloom coming. Water's warm and the sea smells of copper.
Keep off the sand at dusk, Ash. They wash up and they sting.
kai: Saw a Tentacool bloom off the point this morning. Hundreds! Like jelly on toast. Glowing jelly.
lily: Tentacool aren't bugs but they're kind of like jellyfish bugs? No? Okay.
gus: Bloom off the point. Logged. When they come in such numbers, the south is warm.

rumors.title: Gyarados in the storm
rumors.summary: An old superstition: never mock a Magikarp, or a Gyarados will come for your boat in the next storm.

tom: Never laugh at a Magikarp, lad. They remember.
One day it's a Gyarados. And it comes back in a storm, looking for whoever laughed.
kai: I always say sorry to every Magikarp I throw back. Every one. Just in case.
ben: Don't hold with superstition. Still. Wouldn't laugh at a Magikarp. Mm.
mae: My father saw a Gyarados in the storm of '38. Took the end off the old pier like a biscuit.
timmy: Grandpa fought a Gyarados with a LADLE! In a STORM!

rumors.title: The sea lane south
rumors.summary: Route 21 is the sea lane from Pallet Town to Cinnabar. A supply boat runs it weekly; trainers swim it on strong water POKéMON.

gus: Route 21. Supply boat Tuesdays, mail boat when it likes.
Some trainers swim it, riding a Tentacruel or a Lapras. I watch them all the way.
kai: You can't sail straight to Cinnabar, kiddo. Reefs. You go round. I've got a chart. A laminated chart!
marina: Swimmers on Route 21 in summer. Mad, the lot of them. Brave, but mad.
timmy: When I'm big I'm gonna SURF to Cinnabar! On a Gyarados!

rumors.title: A boat without lights
rumors.summary: Gus has twice logged a black-hulled boat running the sea lane at night without lights. It never comes into Pallet harbour.

gus: Twice now, a black boat. No lights. Running south at night.
No name on the hull. A big red letter on the funnel, I thought. Couldn't be sure.
kai: Gus saw a boat with no lights? Probably smugglers. Or a very shy ferry. Ha!
tom: Ships without lights are up to no good, lad. That's the oldest rule of the sea.

rumors.title: Blaine's old fire
rumors.summary: Old Tom says Blaine was once a researcher himself, before he was a Gym Leader. Nobody knows what made him leave.

tom: They say Blaine was a scientist once. Worked in that old mansion, even.
Before the fire. He doesn't talk about it. Burns his secrets, does Blaine.
gus: Blaine has been on Cinnabar longer than his gym. He watches the mansion ruins, I hear. Like a man waiting.

rumors.title: The road to Viridian
rumors.summary: The night's quake shook the slope loose just past Viridian City's south gate. Rocks lie across the road, so Officer Jenny keeps the gate shut while crews clear it.

jenny: Just past this gate the road runs through a cutting. The quake brought the slope down.
Rocks across the road, a crack down the middle. Closed until the surveyors say it's safe.
kai: Ferry radio says the Viridian road's shut! Rockslide! There's an officer on the gate and everything!
ada: They've shut the road to Viridian, dear! A landslide, right across it!
Bram's flour is stuck on the other side. He's beside himself.
ben: Couldn't get the wheat to Viridian market. Road's shut. Rocks. Mm.
bram: No flour from Viridian this week! The road's blocked! I'm baking with what I've got. Creative times, lad! HO HO!

rumors.title: POKéMON thieves
rumors.summary: Viridian's police have reports of two strangers in white uniforms with a big red R, and a Meowth, snooping round POKéMON Centers. Officer Jenny is on the lookout.

jenny: Keep this under your cap. We've had reports of POKéMON thieves near Viridian.
Two strangers in white uniforms with a big red R. And a Meowth. Someone swears it talked. Nonsense.
ada: Thieves, dear! POKéMON thieves, up Viridian way! Two of them, all in white!
And a cat. A TALKING cat. You heard it here first.

chatter._doc: NPC-to-NPC rumour exchanges. a and b list who may speak each part ('any' = anyone); A and B in the lines are filled with them. Picked now and then when two townspeople chat.

lines: Did you feel the shake last night?
The old mountain, grumbling. I'd put money on it.
Smoke over Cinnabar again this morning.
I heard Blaine asks riddles and burns your hat if you're wrong!
Tentacool weather. Keep the little ones off the beach.
That business about the island lab...
Shh. Not in front of the children.
Right. Right. Probably just sailors' talk.
The Cinnabar Lab brings DINOSAURS back to life!
You were smiling. That's how it starts.
Remember when the Cinnabar mansion burned?
Orange sky all night. I'll never forget it.
Nor I. Strange folk, those scientists.
Black boat again last night. No lights.
Since the shake? A rockslide, I heard.
There's an officer up at the gate. Very serious. Very blue.
